verdict_reason: Field set and validation matrix are correct and every mappable component is copied by OperatorService.update, but the hand-copy has no compile-time link to this record and the new public request contract carries no @Schema documentation.

todos.issue: The record's 11 components are the source of truth for the PUT full-replace body, but OperatorService.update hand-copies the 9 mappable ones with no compile-time link; OperatorMapper's unmappedSourcePolicy=ERROR forces a new component to be wired into toEntity (so POST keeps working) while update silently keeps ignoring it, so PUT quietly stops being a full replace
todos.fix: Add a MapStruct in-place method to OperatorMapper - void updateEntity(AddressRequest request, @MappingTarget Address address) with the same id/organisationId/status/createdAt/modifiedAt ignores and type/role ignoreUnmappedSourceProperties - and call it from OperatorService.update instead of the nine setters, so an unmapped new field is a compile error on both paths

todos.issue: New public API request record carries no @Schema on the record or any of its 11 components, so the generated OpenAPI contract has no descriptions, no examples, no requiredMode on the @NotBlank fields, and advertises the unsupported type/role as ordinary free-form Object properties
todos.fix: Add @Schema(description=...) to the record and each component, set requiredMode = REQUIRED on the @NotBlank ones to match Bean Validation, and mark type/role @Schema(hidden = true) so the contract does not advertise fields the service rejects

todos.issue: phone is the only component copied by OperatorService.update that no update test asserts - OperatorServiceTest.updateAppliesTheNewFieldValues checks name/addressLine1/townOrCity/postcode/email and AddressUpdateIT checks name/addressLine1/townOrCity/countryCode plus the cleared optionals, so deleting existing.setPhone(request.phone()) leaves the whole suite green
todos.fix: Assert the replaced phone (and email) in AddressUpdateIT.putReplacesAllFieldsAndClearsOmittedOptionals so every one of the nine copied fields is pinned by at least one update test

todos.issue: countryCode is the only client-supplied string with no upper bound - every other component is @Size-capped - and it is persisted verbatim, so a caller can store an arbitrarily long value (AddressRequestValidationTest pins a 300-char value as valid); it is also indexed-adjacent via searchByCountryCode
todos.fix: Add a generous defensive @Size(max = ...) alongside the @NotBlank - it caps abuse without introducing the ISO list check or the value transformation cv-011 rules out - and update the presence-only test to assert the cap rather than unlimited length
